title: UX-01 task 2: the official card back and the CardBack component
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Implementation-plan task 2 (decision D28): the official card back is stored byte for byte as packages/design-system/src/assets/card-back/lorcana_card_back.jpg (JPEG 1468 x 2048, 486,672 bytes, SHA-256 0f022bc3422c5c0c2adf6bc09ca8196d30e0c78842e0845be7d44b024f5b1dbf), copied from the legacy app's public/assets/cards/ and byte-identical to the LorcanaOnline original. Its manifest.json records the source, the legacy catalog entry (material.card.back, official source, owner-approved 2026-07-02), format and colour space, dimensions and aspect ratio, rendition, language, accessibility use, the neutral fallback, the copies not used and the D07 rights basis (standard §29).

CardBack (Experimental, src/components/CardBack): the official back at the card silhouette, decorative unless given a label; with officialAssets={false}, or if the image fails, a neutral back drawn from tokens (raised surface, essential border, inset decorative rule, forced-colors boundaries). cardBackImageUrl exports the asset URL for presentation code that textures face-down cards. Documentation contract and a story covering the official back, neutral back, small size and labelled card; the Cards documentation page lists it.
copy-static.mjs copies .jpg files to dist/ so the compiled package keeps the asset path; the browser-suite server serves .jpg as image/jpeg; the CSS module type for CardBack is generated.

components.test.mjs checks the card back against its manifest: SHA-256, byte size, the JPEG start-of-image marker, the decoded frame dimensions and the rights basis. RUN-20261022-012 passes the design-system typecheck and all 35 gate tests, including CardBack's documentation and state coverage.
Design-system runbook (face-down cards and the reference fixture) and a new dated UX-01 build section in the design-system validation.
